title: PromptUGAL waits on two words from you, and the agents wait on tokens
headline: Your newsroom and designer agents read WS-177 and stopped, correctly: a relay from me is material, not your word, so they want your go in their own sessions. Your CRM agent made Silvio's 50 and the Brazilian delegation complete in the public CRM, but cannot push without its own SG/Send token; Angelo's agents have also stopped using his token and asked for three. promptugal.news does not resolve yet. The inbox is empty.
